_comment: Deal-screener thresholds. Every tunable introduced by the deal-screener upgrades lives here, never hardcoded in Python (analysis/screener_config.py loads it, hard-fail on missing key like the other config loaders). Break-even-occupancy display/warn are used by DebtMetrics; the price-drop-velocity + seller-bleed triggers by the Deal Context 'Read' (scoring/scorer.py). The mixed_use_* / component_vacancy / commercial_majority_threshold keys drive the mixed-use per-component income engine (analysis/metrics/income.py MixedUseComponents) and apply to property type mixed_use ONLY.
